thread.title: Markets Now: Dow Slides 150 Points as Trade-War Worries Return With a Vengeance

author: Ben Levisohn
title: Markets Now: Dow Slides 150 Points as Trade-War Worries Return With a Vengeance
text:
By Ben Levisohn Updated Aug. 2, 2018 8:21 a.m. ET Want to know why the Dow Jones Industrial Average is doing what it's doing? Check back here for a semi-live look at the volatile markets from Barron's reporters.
7:45 a.m. Trade-war concerns aren't going away after all, and that has the market feeling a bit down Thursday morning. S&P 500 futures have fallen 0.5%, while Dow Jones Industrial Average futures have dropped 150 points, or 0.6%. Nasdaq Composite futures have slumped 0.7%.
The Trump administration said it was considering putting levies of 25% on $200 billion of Chinese goods , up from 10%. "A $200 billion salvo of levies on Chinese imports would be a considerable step-up in the trade dispute between US and China and would start to seriously threaten global growth," writes Konstantinos Anthis , head of research at ADSS .
Of course, these reports were out there yesterday, but Apple's (AAPL) good day obscured the damage .
